text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu, haa*...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...... Man~~... No good, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was a heated race. Though the 
outcome was a bit unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look over there! Mihono Bourbon and 
Rice Shower are—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You've leveled up several notches since 
the Satsuki Sho. Marking you made that 
abundantly clear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon...!

The conversation between the two gets the 
crowd in the stands all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower has been chasing after Bourbon 
this whole time, huh. Both of them ran 
such an amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is a long-distance race, 
right?! This is... I can't wait to see 
Rice Shower in action!

At Tokyo Racecourse, everyone's gaze was 
completely captivated by the two of them.
Meanwhile, Matikanetannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aha~, silly me, this time it felt like I 
was just so, so close.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah... ...I'm so frustrated!

Matikanetannhauser always gave it her all, 
but for the once-in-a-lifetime Nippon 
Derby, she was especially fired up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Because I'm plain, I'm ordinary! There is 
completely, absolutely nothing special 
about me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, but even so... talking about the 
possibility of winning is another matter 
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Because even for me, anything less than 
1st place is completely useless!"

...That said, things don't always end the 
way you want them to.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's a race I'll never have the chance to 
win again. So I was determined that I just 
had to take it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that's why, that's precisely 
why...!

Matikane Tannhauser hung her head. Her 
shoulders trembled, her fists clenched 
tightly――

The surrounding cameras zoomed in, as if 
waiting for the tears to come, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What's important is what comes next, 
what's next!

When she briskly raised her head, she wore 
her usual cheerful expression.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's always next time! I'll learn from 
this and give it my absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you see Matikanetannhauser's 
press conference?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! You know, I lost my race today 
too, so watching that really cheered me 
up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"They told me, ‘Onto the next one, the 
next one!’ Hehe. I want to be able to say 
things like that too."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eep. That's so embarrassiiing...!

Matikanetannhauser's positive attitude and 
cheerful words struck a chord with many 
people.

Next is the Kikuka Sho. As always, I have 
no intention of losing.
